hook.name: Pangea Fee Hook
hook.description: Takes a fixed trading fee (0.3%–5%, set once per pool at launch) in the pool's quote asset via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, routing fees to a per-pool splitter. The launch's first buy is fee-free, liquidity additions are restricted to a single registered seeder, and swaps that would push the price beyond the launch's range are reverted.
